description: Angular component for a photo camera widget in the Thingsboard platform, handling camera access, photo capture, and data upload.

classes.name: PhotoCameraInputWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for capturing photos via web camera, supporting device selection, photo preview, and uploading.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up camera detection, and configures settings.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up media tracks when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: updateWidgetData
methods.description: Updates the widget with new data, including last captured photo.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Handles data updates from the data source.

methods.name: detectAvailableDevices
methods.description: Detects available video input devices and checks camera support.

methods.name: getVideoAspectRatio
methods.description: Calculates the aspect ratio of the video stream.

methods.name: takePhoto
methods.description: Starts video stream to take a photo.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Stops video stream and closes camera view.

methods.name: savePhoto
methods.description: Saves the captured photo to the data source.

methods.name: switchWebCamera
methods.description: Switches to the next available camera device.

methods.name: createPhoto
methods.description: Captures a photo from the video stream and creates a preview.

methods.name: saveImageToGallery
methods.description: Uploads the photo to the image service and returns the link.

methods.name: inititedVideoStream
methods.description: Initializes the video stream from the selected camera device.

methods.name: get textMessage
methods.description: Provides user message based on current camera and data state.
